Chapter 1408 - 18: Breakthrough, Second Realm (Part 2)

Chapter 1408: Chapter 18: Breakthrough, Second Realm (Part 2)

The commotion was immense.

The myriad laws and paths of the entire Source World were influenced by this.

A Second Realm time life form, even if going all out, couldn’t possibly shake the Source World, let alone just comprehend their own Chaotic Origin Dao?

It’s crucial to understand that the pursuit of the Master of Wushan is to draw a ’Source World.’

Achieving this would mark the moment of becoming a Time Lord.

It stands to reason that the power capable of shaking the entire Source World undoubtedly belongs to the level of a Third Realm Time Lord.

"Infinite, have you discovered anything?"

The Master of Black Space noticed something unusual in the expression of the Master of Infinite and immediately inquired.

The Eternal Lords around also turned their gaze over.

"Nothing much."

The Master of Infinite did not directly voice their thoughts, because they were somewhat unsure.

Instead, with a hint of deeper meaning, they said, "I just saw the Galaxy comprehending its own Origin Dao, much like back in the days of training under our teacher."

The ’teacher’ mentioned by the Master of Infinite naturally referred to the Lord of Heaven Light.

Who is also a Time Lord.

"With the practice speed of the ’Galaxy,’ there’s no problem in reaching the heights of our ’teacher’ someday."

The Master of Black Space quickly affirmed the view of the Master of Infinite.

The Third Realm Lord, challenging for other time life forms, probably means nothing in Lin Yuan’s eyes; it’s only a matter of time.

"Hmm?"

The Master of Infinite glanced sideways at the Master of Black Space, saying no more.

Before the future?

The implication of their earlier words was that the current ’Galaxy’ gave them a feeling not much different from the Lord of Heaven Light.

Is there a need to wait until the future?

But this hypothesis is so incredible.

Just comprehending its own Origin Dao, already on par with Third Realm Lords?

...

The First Source World.

Six Ancestors immediately sensed the fluctuation of the Origin Dao.

"Simply a monster, how long has it been?" The Da Fu Ancestor was internally shocked, yet slightly fortunate for humbling themselves to Lin Yuan from the start.

The scene in the future timeline will likely occur now.

No, it should be harsher than the timeline observed.

The enmity of a Second Realm time life form in the same dimensional space is unbearable for any First Realm time life form.

This is different from a Second Realm life form in a dimensional gap.

When facing a Second Realm time life form in a dimensional gap, the Da Fu Ancestor was at most apprehensive, knowing that as long as they stayed within the Source World, nothing could be done to them.

With the protection of Source World consciousness, even a Time Lord has to pay a price to harm them, let alone a Second Realm time life form?

But a Second Realm life form in the same dimensional space... can completely ignore the Source World protection and directly attack the Da Fu Ancestor.

Then, the Da Fu Ancestor’s many survival methods would be useless, even becoming weaknesses.

"Fierce Sun, your luck..." The Da Ling Ancestor glanced at the Fierce Sun Ancestor.

Though the Ancestors were independent, Lin Yuan was from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country after all.

Now that Lin Yuan became a Second Realm time life form, their status is undoubtedly the highest.

Among those below Lin Yuan, the Fierce Sun Ancestor ranks next, unavoidable because of the connection.

In terms of strength, the Da Fu Ancestor is the strongest, followed by the Da Ling Ancestor, and the Fierce Sun Ancestor was not prominent among the original six Ancestors.

But now, taking advantage of the connection with Galaxy, they surpassed them all.

"Hahaha." The Fierce Sun Ancestor smiled.

In terms of cultivating their offspring, the Fierce Sun Ancestor was not as adept as the Da Fu Ancestor, but Lin Yuan hails from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country by chance.

"We come from the same dimensional space, and during the great cataclysm in the future, we need to join forces against other time life forms." The Fierce Sun Ancestor immediately stated.

For time life forms like them, true challenges only arise after the great cataclysm upon entering dimensional gaps.

"Right."

The Thunder Origin Ancestor nodded, acknowledging their less close ties with Galaxy compared to the Fierce Sun Ancestor.

Ultimately, they come from the same dimensional space, belonging to the same camp that needs to remain united against external threats in the future.

...

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, and before him, a vast Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao had completely formed.

"Is this my Origin Dao?" Lin Yuan carefully examined it, noting that the power of the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao far exceeded that of the Chaotic Origin Destruction Dao.

"Normal Second Realm time life forms typically comprehend their own Chaotic Origin Dao before understanding other Chaotic Origin Daos, but I did it the other way around, understanding other Daos first before the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao."

Lin Yuan felt a surge of joy, fundamentally because the comprehension difficulty of the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao was too high.

This could be seen from the time when Lin Yuan first comprehended the Chaotic Taiji Dao, where other Chaos Realm beings accomplished their own chaotic evolutionary paths with just a threshold of Chaos Rule.

Whereas Lin Yuan nearly achieved Chaos Rule completion before understanding the Chaotic Taiji Dao.

"I can feel that by comprehending the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao and stepping into the Second Realm, my strength is not different from a Time Lord."

Lin Yuan assessed themselves, being no weaker in direct combat than any usual Third Realm Time Lord. As for mastery over timelines and concealing their own timeline, with the blessing of the Lord rank, there was no difference from a Time Lord.

Moreover, one of the strongest methods of a Time Lord, traveling to the past to slay enemies in their weaker periods... However, upon condensing a "past self," Lin Yuan’s past equates to his present. Any Time Lord daring to travel to the past to kill him would pay a tragic price.

For Time Lords, past spacetime repels them, and forcing entry involves constant backlash, with even greater costs for taking action there.

But Lin Yuan’s past self? Being of the past, faced no repulsion, and battling Time Lords from the future would be straightforward combat for him.

"Now, if I claim to be a Time Lord, no one would question it, real Third Realm Lords wouldn’t notice any difference."

Lin Yuan pondered internally.

In truth, even if they noticed, what of it? In the dimensional gap, strength reigns supreme, with Lin Yuan being able to rival Time Lords by all means, he indeed is a Time Lord.

Who dares to question?

In fact, Lin Yuan’s methods were far more terrifying than those of a Time Lord, wielding World-Breaking Origin Force as a deadly weapon, capable even of completely killing an actual Time Lord.

Shattering the myth of Time Lords being undying unless willing to die.

Of course, this requires a vast amount of World-Breaking Origin Force, and unless absolutely necessary, Lin Yuan would not choose this path.

...

The Third Source World, Great Wilderness Origin World, at the end of the Celestial Road.

With the comprehension of the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao, the Spacetime Great Dao at the end of the Celestial Road was affected, beginning to ripple centered around Lin Yuan.

Initially, the Red Dust Immortals did not show much shock.

Red Dust Immortals comprehending their own Origin Dao to become Immortal Kings wasn’t an unheard-of occurrence along the Celestial Road. Many of the more than ten Immortal Kings came this way.

But as the ripple effects expanded, even influencing one Immortal Road after another.

All the Red Dust Immortals displayed confusion and disbelief.

Wasn’t it just comprehending one’s own Chaotic Origin Dao; why such a great upheaval?

"It’s Emperor Tianyuan."

"Wait, I’m unsure, wasn’t Emperor Tianyuan not even an Immortal King before?"

The Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings were incredulous, realizing that the recently showcased prowess surpassing the Immortal King’s peak by Emperor Tianyuan, was he just an ordinary Red Dust Immortal like them? Not even an Immortal King?

"Tianyuan, my dear fellow..."

From the Shadow World, three Immortal Emperors, who longed for the day when Lin Yuan could join them, were about to continue studying the illusory world when they perceived the emergence of the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

"Ah..."
